title: Queue reorder
description: A lifted track follows the pointer while neighboring tracks move into their new slots before release.
useCase: Reorder a short listening queue with immediate spatial feedback and equivalent keyboard controls.
interaction: Drag a handle across rows or use Up/Down, Home and End. Escape cancels an in-progress drag.
reducedMotion: Finite transitions become immediate under reduced motion and keyboard input. Host pause disables controls; any owned drag is cancelled.
limitations: Fixed three-row queue and original vector covers; no playback, virtualized rows, auto-scroll or cross-list transfer.
look: Dark charcoal page with a rounded graphite card listing three tracks, each with square geometric cover art, white title, grey artist and a dotted grip.
motion: Dragging a grip lifts its row to follow the pointer while neighbours slide into their new slots with a 220 ms ease-out; release settles it, Escape restores the original order.
adapt: Rows sit at `translateY` multiples of `STEP` and animate via the `track` CSS transition (220ms `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`); `gesture` holds the drag and `reorder` moves the item at `Math.round(y / STEP)`. Replace `TRACKS` and `Cover` with your items; keep `finish` for cancel.
